source_atoms.proposition: coerceTypes accepts two int depth codes and bool muldiv, returning int; no array/image buffer parameter.
Equal depths select the first depth before any operation-flag branch.
Negated muldiv participates only in the nested unequal integer-boundary choice.
Selected non-muldiv coercion path calls helper for input depths, then again with requested output depth.
Selected muldiv coercion path similarly passes true to both helper calls.
Later operation-specific branch can raise wtype to at least CV_32F before type construction.
The shape helper appends acn/bcn to the shape arrays.
Its loop starts at each last index and continues only while both remain nonnegative.
A visited pair rejects only if unequal and neither dimension equals1.
Thus appended channel dimensions are tested first by the same predicate, not a separate equality-only condition.
Unmatched leading dimensions are not visited after either reverse index is exhausted; not a whole InputArray validity claim.
Caller fallback block requires neither operand initially scalar, then probes scalar-like geometry and failed shape compatibility.
Fallback sets s1=like1 and s2=like2&&!like1, preferring first when both qualify.

caller-working-type-adjustment.note: Two calls are qualified to coercion paths, not same-depth fast branch or every public API. Laterwtypeadjustment/sourcebackendlimits retained; extra paragraph procedural/sourcebounds checked, not new runtime observations.

operation-flag-precedence.note: Conditional expression selects equal-depth result first. Flag is nested in later unequal integer-boundary branch; no claim about arbitrary numeric macro values.

type-helper-not-image-conversion.note: Complete helper signature/body supports source-local absence of imagebuffer/outputarray/conversion effects; not a negative claim about all OpenCV.

channel-dimension-broadcasting.note: Appendedchannelpairvisitedfirst;sameunequal/neither1predicateallowsvisitedonecase. Later visited mismatch canreject. No measuredactualbroadcastresult.

scalar-fallback-consumer.note: False helperresult participates in a condition choosing scalarflags, not an immediate unconditional reject of wholearithmeticoperation. Extra limitations deny benchmarks/apps/tests and keep example illustrative.

trailing-dimension-comparison.note: Onlyjointnonnegativeindiceswalked; unmatchedleadingdimensionsnotcheckedhere. Wordingselectedtrailingcomparison preserves narrow scope.
